caesar.name: Shift code
caesar.summary: Every letter moved forward by the same number of places.
steps: The first word is THE. Count forward from T to the first letter you see. That tells you how many places.
Move each letter of the second word back by that many places.
The alphabet loops, so Z is followed by A.
caesar.example: Example: if THE is written UIF, every letter moved 1 place. So DBU decodes to CAT.

atbash.name: Mirror code
atbash.summary: The alphabet was flipped, so each letter swapped with its partner in this chart.
chart: A B C D E F G H I J K L M
Z Y X W V U T S R Q P O N
steps: Find each letter of the second word in the chart.
Swap it for the letter directly above or below it.
Try this on the first word. It should give THE.

pairswap.name: Swap code
pairswap.summary: Each pair of letters was swapped.
steps: Split the word into pairs of letters, starting from the left.
Swap the two letters in each pair.
pairswap.example: Example: OB TA becomes BO AT, which spells BOAT.
